citizens.title: Experience Owner, Contact Center Platform & AI Experience
citizens.personallyDid: Owned the roadmap, strategy and delivery plan for the conversational AI and intent-based routing workstream, within a major bank's move from a legacy Cisco IVR to Amazon Connect. Led a matrixed team of 10 (architects, engineers, QA, business analysts) across eight epics. Defined the requirements and release validation for the AI components, and worked with engineering and data science on the design.

achievements.text: Took the conversational system to a limited production launch. Card-processing intents went live to real retail customers of Citizens Access and ran for a month before I left.
achievements.basis: Launch is a fact. No outcome claim; I don't have post-launch numbers.

achievements.text: Rationalized a 259-intent legacy catalog to a 52-intent MVP, then to 22 intents, each assigned a fulfillment path. Classification testing changed the model: a first cut to 10 intents failed and was redrawn.

Set pre-release gates: over 90% classification accuracy, under 1% hallucination, over 95% consistency, over 95% out-of-scope capture. Evaluated against a 768-row labeled benchmark across ten prompt versions.
Presented the workstream's roadmap to EVP and SVP stakeholders and secured approval to proceed.

optimizelyGenAI.title: Principal Product Manager, Generative AI, ML & Personalization
optimizelyGenAI.personallyDid: Owned GenAI product strategy and roadmap across 10+ product lines. Owned the internal model garden, a shared foundation-model layer for product engineering teams. Led a matrixed team of 10 data scientists and developers. Set up model evaluation through experimentation. Defined which customer data could reach model providers. Built the documentation bot over the company's full document set.

achievements.text: The model garden accelerated AI deployment cycles 80–90%, because each team no longer had to build its own model integration.
Brought Google's PaLM 2 models from Vertex AI into the garden; corroborated by Optimizely's Aug 29, 2023 press release.
Another team shipped a customer-facing GenAI feature (the AI variation generator) on the platform's access and tooling.
GenAI capabilities shipped across 10+ product lines under the Opal brand.

optimizelyConnect.title: Principal Product Manager, Optimizely Connect Platform
optimizelyConnect.personallyDid: Took the Connect Platform, a serverless developer and app-marketplace platform, from pilot to production launch. Defined its APIs and SDKs. Assessed and onboarded 30+ third-party integrations. Wrote most of the v1 developer documentation myself.

achievements.text: Active, daily-used apps grew from 3 to 35 in the three months after launch.
Developer time for new apps down 60%, because developers no longer built, hosted and maintained their own integrations.
Customer deployment time down 80–90%: installation went from an integration project to picking an app in the marketplace.
The core v1 developer documentation remains substantially in place in what Optimizely publishes today.
